keyEvents.text: Delay in match because of an injury Christoph Lang (LASK).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, LASK. Moses Usor replaces Christoph Lang because of an injury.
Substitution, LASK. Sascha Horvath replaces Alessandro Schöpf.
Krystof Danek (LASK) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, LASK. Daniel Elfadli replaces Krystof Danek.
Substitution, Bodø/Glimt. Ulrik Saltnes replaces Sondre Fet.
Substitution, Bodø/Glimt. Joshua Kitolano replaces Sondre Auklend.
Substitution, Bodø/Glimt. Andreas Helmersen replaces Ola Brynhildsen.
Substitution, LASK. Sasa Kalajdzic replaces Samuel Adeniran.
Substitution, LASK. Melayro Bogarde replaces Kasper Jørgensen.
Jostein Gundersen (Bodø/Glimt) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Bodø/Glimt. Isak Määttä replaces Jens Petter Hauge.
Own Goal by Melayro Bogarde, LASK. Bodø/Glimt 1, LASK 0.
